File order and updated_at agree on which revision is last for all 917 repeated orders. 126 of those revisions change the status, so keeping the last revision rather than the first moves net revenue from 3,010,704.83 to 3,023,296.61. date_input_formats (slashed dates are month-first) agrees with order_month on all 6,852 slashed dates; a day-first reading would contradict order_month on 2,424 of them. Converting to Europe/Warsaw moves no ISO-8601 timestamp to a different day, and no published figure uses order_date.

shipping_locale fits the data: 30% of shipping cells are written in the declared locale and 8% carry a EUR suffix, and all of them were read. Stripping the separators instead would turn the unpublished shipping_total from 37,792,722.50 into 1,248,402,183.11.

Within each of PL, DE and CZ, direct completes at 0.721 to 0.726 and partner at 0.595 to 0.613; within each month, direct completes at 0.719 to 0.732 and partner at 0.595 to 0.616. The dashboard AOV cards say neither 'delivered orders only' nor 'net of refunds'.
